title: SSE test reader mistakes keep-alive comments for application events
outcome: Observed in full scripts/test-rust.sh under coordinator GO: 2087 passed, 1 failed, 3 ignored. tests::http_routes::state_events_route_recovers_after_ordered_broadcaster_delta_overflow failed at src/tests/http_routes.rs:2195: expected lagged marker, got ":\n\n". Read-only diagnosis: src/tests/mod.rs:1672 next_sse_event returns the first blank-line-terminated frame indiscriminately; src/api_sse.rs:306 enables KeepAlive::default(). A legal comment-only keep-alive therefore becomes a false application event in the fixture. Classification: test helper defect, not evidence of lost production lagged recovery. Existing tracker searches for broadcaster, SSE, keep-alive and next_sse_event found no matching task. Next action: coordinator grants a focused reproduction with a deterministic comment frame followed by a lagged event, fixes frame filtering while preserving event boundaries, then reruns the original full Rust wrapper. No timeout inflation or repeat-until-green. No unowned source/test edit has been made.
